snippet.title: Lost in Fantaland - Announcement Trailer (PS4, PS5, Switch)
snippet.description: Lost in Fantaland is a tactical card RPG where players use action cards on a grid-based board to survive battles with minimal damage. Will launch on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5 on October 9, 2025!
